text:
Maya Lin: Heads up — US-EAST Dedicated GPU pool is at 98% utilization, queue length 4x baseline. We're seeing pod restarts with OOMs and the autoscaler didn't add GPUs in the last 8m.
Jamal Carter: :eyes: Any immediate errors in the autoscaler logs? Could be the quota check or a spot shortage.
Maya Lin: quick grep shows node provisioning attempts failing with 'NoCapacity' from the cloud provider. Also networking flaps to one AZ.
Priya Singh: I'm going to open a temporary routing rule to shift non-SLA traffic to hosted-US-EAST. Prefer to avoid full failover — want to keep enterprise customers on Dedicated.
Luca Romano: +1. Can we route by customer_tier header? That keeps A/B experiments unaffected.
Priya Singh: doing that now. Rule:
```
route(
  if: request.headers['x-customer-tier'] == 'standard',
  to: hosted-us-east,
  ttl: 600
)
```
Priya Singh: applied. It should affect only standard/low-priority routes. :thumbsup:
Maya Lin: what's the expected cost delta if that stays for 10m? Quick estimate please.
Jamal Carter: rough calc: standard traffic ~30% of tokens; hosted runs ~2.5x unit cost for same model right now due to reserved discount loss. So bill delta ~ +75% on that subset while spill is active. Not catastrophic for 10m but watch signs.
ops-bot: alert: asg-us-east-ggx scaled 0 -> 1 -> 0 (6 events in 7m). Event: ProvisioningFailed: NoCapacity.
Luca Romano: looks like an AZ-level capacity fragment. Suggest draining nodes from that AZ and roll pods to other AZs in the pool.
Maya Lin: will coordinate with cloud team to attempt cross-AZ provisioning. In the meantime, enable per-route rate limit for experimental endpoints to reduce token churn.
Priya Singh: rate limits applied to /v1/execute for routes with header x-experiment:true -> 10 req/min.
Jamal Carter: also recommending we enable short-lived KV cache for prefixes to reduce repeated prefix expansion — small config push incoming.
Priya Singh: pushed cache tweak. Monitoring QPS and GPU mem now.
Maya Lin: thanks. I'll keep the thread updated. If autoscaler reports success, we rollback the hosted rule. Otherwise, extend TTL.
deploy-bot: deploy successful: feature/route-ttl-600 -> prod (chores) by Priya Singh at 1755500402
Maya Lin: current status: queue length down 35% after routing change, GPU mem pressure down slightly. Still watch for provisioning events. Next update in 5m. :mag:
Luca Romano: I'll open a ticket to track billing impact and follow-up on AZ capacity with our cloud vendor.
Priya Singh: noted. Also creating a follow-up to add a fallback policy that prefers spinning up cross-region prewarmed nodes before routing to hosted in future.
Maya Lin: perfect. Thanks team.
